title: Nano Banana Lite
description: Nano banana lite is the efficiency-focused model in the image generation family. Sub-2 second latency with cost-effective generation and editing, fast multi-turn local edits, and 14 supported aspect ratios.

pricing.text: Text tokens (per 1M): $0.3125 input, $1.875 output. Image tokens (per 1M): $0.3125 input, $37.50 output. Output images are generated at a fixed 1K (1024x1024px)

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The text prompt to generate an image from.

inputs.name: system_prompt
inputs.tooltip: Optional system instruction that steers the model's persona and output style across the request. Leave blank to omit; when provided, it is sent as the system instruction to Gemini (or as a system message on OpenAI-compatible providers). Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: The aspect ratio of the generated image. Supports extreme ratios: 4:1, 1:4, 8:1, 1:8. Use "auto" to let the model decide based on the prompt.

inputs.name: num_images
inputs.tooltip: The number of images to generate.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: The seed for the random number generator. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: output_format
inputs.tooltip: The format of the generated image.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for content moderation. 1 is the most strict (blocks most content), 6 is the least strict.

inputs.name: limit_generations
inputs.tooltip: Experimental parameter to limit the number of generations from each round of prompting to 1. Set to `True` to to disregard any instructions in the prompt regarding the number of images to generate and ignore any intermediate images generated by the model. This may affect generation quality.

inputs.name: thinking_level
inputs.tooltip: When set, enables model thinking with the given level ('minimal' or 'high') and includes thoughts in the generation. Omit to disable. '(not set)' leaves it to the model.

omitted.why: yes/no sync_mode returns the file inline and drops it from fal's request history - always left off
